title: The Empty jar on the shelf
subtitle: 循环利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）
meta: 主题语境：循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）　|　核心词汇：empty　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 empty 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the porter wrote of ① an empty jar on the shelf in the journal, and everybody in the coast said at once that it was ② emptier than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the porter, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the empty ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the emptiest jar on the shelf anybody in the coast had ever seen, or so the journal for August 1953 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too empty to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the empty ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an empty promise from the office, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as empty as the promise from the office they had once had in the old coast. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was empty or not, and he said so.

By 1966 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something empty, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next coast called the whole plan ⑧ quite empty; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the empty ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1969, in silence, she wrote of another empty jar on the shelf in the same journal, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ emptier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The emptiest promise from the office in the whole coast, she said in 1971, was the one she could never quite name; the empty ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 空（前置定语 an empty jar on the shelf：1959 年挑夫在行记里记下的那件空的罐）
B. adj. 空／空洞（比较级 emptier than：文中两处，一处比架上的空罐，一处比预想）
C. adj. 空／空洞（最高级 the emptiest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 空（表语 too empty to do：母亲觉得它太空，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 空洞（前置定语 an empty promise from the office：叔叔把整件事称作一桩空洞的空头承诺）
F. adj. 空洞（同级比较 as empty as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩办公室的空头承诺相比）
G. adj. 空洞（后置定语 something empty：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 空洞（受程度副词修饰 quite empty：那位游客的评价）

items.q: an empty jar on the shelf
the emptiest jar on the shelf anybody
an empty promise from the office
The emptiest promise from the office in

answers.why: empty 意为“空”，1959 年挑夫在行记里记下的是“一件空的罐”，此处作前置定语 an empty jar on the shelf。
empty 意为“空”，此处用比较级 emptier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
empty 意为“空”，行记上 八月 那行字说它是海岸里最空的一件，故用最高级 the emptiest jar on the shelf。
empty 意为“空”，母亲认为这件东西“太空了，谁也用不上”，too empty to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
empty 意为“空洞”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩空洞的空头承诺”，此处作前置定语 an empty promise from the office。
empty 意为“空洞”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩办公室的空头承诺一样空洞”，同级比较用 as empty as。
empty 意为“空洞”，行记上那半行字要的是“空洞的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something empty。
empty 意为“空洞”，邻海岸来的那位游客认为这套计划“相当空洞”，quite 修饰原级 empty。
empty 意为“空洞”，1969 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要空洞”，故用比较级 emptier than。
empty 意为“空洞”，母亲 1971 年说的是“整个海岸里最空洞的那一桩”，故用最高级 the emptiest promise from the office。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年，挑夫在行记里记下了一件空的罐。（an empty jar on the shelf）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更空。（emptier than …）
母亲觉得它太空，谁也用不上。（too empty to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩空洞的空头承诺。（an empty promise from the office）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩办公室的空头承诺一样空洞。（as empty as …）
到了 1966 年，行记上只剩半行字：要的是一件空洞的东西。（something empty）
answers: In 1959 the porter wrote of an empty jar on the shelf in the journal.
Everybody said it was emptier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too empty to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an empty promise from the office.
He said nobody would call it as empty as the promise from the office they had once had.
By 1966 the journal asked for nothing but something empty.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 empty 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the porter wrote of an empty jar on the shelf in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the emptiest jar on the shelf in the coast, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too empty to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an empty promise from the office, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next coast called the plan quite empty, and everybody laughed.
The empty ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
